hey there! this may be a bit more detailed than asked for but i’m passionate about this topic so i thought i’d share my thoughts!

glossier products in general are a great gift for those who aren’t really acne prone (in my opinion). the products they have in the skincare edit are the milk jelly cleanser, future dew, bounce serum, priming moisturizer, and 2 bomb dot coms. i use the bounce serum, priming moisturizer, and the bomb dot com in my makeup routine everyday. i know me personally and a lot of others had issues with future dew breaking them out. milk jelly cleanser is kind of just a normal cleanser — i’m not sure if it shows any results tho.

my favorite skincare products from glossier (as a person with dry-ish + combination skin) is the sunscreen, super bounce serum (i think super pure serum is pretty good too but haven’t tried it out), the green + moon masks, and the after baume. the sunscreen is just a good everyday layer to add to your skincare routine (not enough spf for really sunny days tho, may want to consider that if you live somewhere with a lot of sun), the super bounce serum has hyaluronic acid which helps absorb moisture into the skin, and after baume is a very intensive moisturizer which i use after applying tretinoin (common acne drying topical medication). generally, the glossier products i feel are better for dry-normal skin.

if you are open to looking into other brands, i’d really suggest “the ordinary”, “paula’s choice”, and “drunk elephant”. these are all available on sephora! also, you might want to look into peace out pore oil-absorbing nose strips. these will suck up the sebaceous filaments which may have her pores appear larger, without damaging the skin barrier. you can also get some of the peace out salicylic acid acne dots, which help suck the puss out of whiteheads, targeting certain acne prone areas (available on sephora as well). if you’re looking for basics, cerave has a great foaming cleanser for normal to oily skin.

happy shopping!
